description: The true path of the miniature: a room with two doors, each watched by a different witness for a different stretch; neither watch alone closes any of the time, and together they leave the hours after dusk and the one who was out of sight in them.

moves.see: the passage door of the garden room was shut
moves.why: I had the passage door before me the whole four hours.

moves.see: the terrace door of the garden room was shut
moves.why: And Dunn had the other door before him until dusk.

moves.see: Mr. Farrant was in the passage
moves.why: After dusk Mr. Farrant was with me.
He passed the door a dozen times while it was watched, and was with me when it was not.

moves.see: Philip Wray was not in the passage
moves.why: Philip left me at dusk, when Dunn left the terrace.
Philip, after dusk, by the terrace door.
